raw_segments.text: Juliet, O serpent-heart, hid with a flowering face, did ever dragon keep so fair a cave.
Beautiful tyrant, fiend-angelical, dove-feathered raven, wolfish ravening lamb, despised substance
of divinest show, just opposite to what thou justly seems to, a damned saint, an honorable
O nature, what hadst thou to do in hell when thou didst bower the spirit of a fiend in
mortal paradise of such sweet flesh?
Was ever book containing such vile matter so fairly bound?
Oh, that deceit should dwell in such a gorgeous palace.
